lines.text: The caravans of Dedanites must lodge in the thickets of Arabia.
The dwellers of Tyre are told to bring water for the thirsty and meet the refugees with food.
The refugees flee from the drawn sword, the bent bow, and the stress of battle.
Within three years, as a hired worker would count it, all the glory of Kedar will be gone.
The remaining archers, the warriors of Kedar, will be few, for the LORD, the God of Israel, has spoken.
